title: Black Bob Thunderbird figurine
subtitle: Chibi figurine of the costume mascot · 80 mm tall on a display base · red, white, black · millimetres

meshes.label: White (beak, eyeballs, highlights, chest blaze, legs, feet, B B)

scale_note: 80 mm tall is a first guess for a 'little' figurine. Type a different height in the real-size box to preview it; HEIGHT_MM in build.py sets it.
notes_title: v20: a real cap (your pick, B, with the bill attached)
notes: v20 = v19 + hat option B, with the bill fixed so it's attached. The crown is 25% taller. The bill is now a proper visor that is one piece with the cap's base: it comes straight out of the front of the cap, starts flat, and curves down at the sides and dips a little at the front, but only in front of the crown, so nothing hangs below the hat. The BB is bigger (about 60% taller) and raised 0.6 mm from the cap, staggered like the costume's. The figure is still 80 mm tall overall, so the taller hat makes the rest of the bird very slightly smaller.
